title: Sagrada Familia
blurb: Antoni Gaudi’s unfinished basilica in Barcelona. Its forest of branching columns carries hyperboloid vaults up to 75 m, and its planned 18 spires rise to 172.5 m, the tallest church tower in the world since February 2026.

sourceUrls.label: Sagrada Familia official booklet 7: Passion Facade
Sagrada Familia official booklet 8: Glory Facade
Popular Science: Tower of Jesus completed February 2026

systems.name: Apostle towers
systems.description: Twelve spires, one per apostle, each rising 100 m, with four on each facade.

systems.name: Evangelist towers
systems.description: Four spires at 135 m around the crossing, each crowned by its evangelist symbol.

systems.name: Jesus and Mary towers
systems.description: The 172.5 m Tower of Jesus Christ and the 138 m Tower of the Virgin Mary.

systems.name: Nativity Facade
systems.description: The sunrise facade on the northeast, built under Gaudi, celebrating the birth of Christ.

systems.name: Passion Facade
systems.description: The sunset facade on the southwest, with Subirachs austere sculptures of the final days of Christ.

systems.name: Glory Facade
systems.description: The main southern entrance, under construction, shown here as designed.

systems.name: Nave and branching columns
systems.description: The forest of tree-like columns on a 7.5 m grid that carries the vaults without flying buttresses.

systems.name: Roofs and vaults
systems.description: Hyperboloid and barrel vaults from 30 m in the aisles to 75 m in the apse.

systems.name: Apse and ambulatory
systems.description: Seven chapels ringing the apse behind the ambulatory.

systems.name: Cloister and chapels
systems.description: The cloister surrounding the church, a layout original in Christian architecture.

systems.name: Crypt and foundations
systems.description: The crypt and foundations begun under Francisco de Paula del Villar.

systems.name: Stained glass
systems.description: Colored glass flooding the interior with light.

explanations.barnabas spire pinnacle: Colorful Venetian mosaic pinnacle crowning the Barnabas spire. Gaudi studied tubular bells for the towers for years; they are to be installed last. Exact pinnacle shape is schematic.

explanations.jesus christ spire shaft: The Tower of Jesus Christ rises to 172.5 m, the tallest church tower in the world since its exterior was completed on 20 February 2026, passing Ulm Minster at 162 m. Built from twelve intersecting paraboloids of tensioned stone panels, it rests on four monumental porphyry columns at the crossing. Exact profile is schematic.
